items.title: A Repair Estimate Is Not Necessarily a Notice of Bad Faith in Louisiana
items.summary: A commentary asks whether a contractor's repair estimate, far higher than what a Louisiana property insurer paid after a hurricane, started the clock on the cure period for bad faith penalties. The insurer let sixty days pass and the insured then sued for penalties. This is Louisiana law, so it is persuasive only in Missouri, and only the opening of the piece was available, so the answer is not covered here.

items.title: California Group Off the Hook for Defamation Suit Brought by Maine Lobster Industry
items.summary: The First Circuit Court of Appeals dismissed a defamation lawsuit brought by Maine lobster interests against a California environmental group that urged the public to avoid eating North American lobster. This is a federal appeals decision from outside Missouri, so it is persuasive only here. Only the opening of the article was available, so the court's reasoning is not covered.

items.title: Judge grants Mizzou player TRO over NCAA eligibility rules
items.summary: Per the headline, a judge granted a Mizzou player a temporary restraining order over NCAA eligibility rules. The source is paywalled and no excerpt was available, so this summary is the headline only and no other details are known.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 20: Salesforce Agrees to Acquire Braze for $5.66 Billion: BRZE Stock Soars 52%
items.summary: On Oct. 20, 2026, the board of Braze unanimously backed a $47.50 per share offer from Salesforce, a deal valued at $5.66 billion. The headline says Braze stock soared 52% on the news.

items.title: Should Earnings Beat Require Action From Wells Fargo (WFC) Investors?
items.summary: Wells Fargo reported third quarter 2026 results with higher net interest income and net income than a year earlier, and it reaffirmed its full year net interest income guidance. The article asks whether the earnings beat should lead investors to act. Only the opening was available.

items.title: Alphabet set for earnings beat as Cloud and AI chips take centre stage
items.summary: Bank of America expects Alphabet to deliver a modest earnings beat next week, with Google Cloud growth and rising demand for its custom AI chips offsetting signs of slowing Search growth. Only the opening of the article was available.

items.title: State education officials say Normandy schools are financially stressed. District asks voters for help on Nov. ballot
items.summary: St. Louis Public Radio reports that state education officials say the Normandy schools are financially stressed, and the district is asking voters for help on the November ballot. Only the headline was available, so no further details are known.

items.title: Data centers could pay for residents’ solar panels under St. Louis bill
items.summary: The Post-Dispatch headline says a St. Louis bill would have data centers pay for residents' solar panels. The source is paywalled and only the headline was available, so no details are known.

items.title: Missouri voters to consider 5 statewide propositions. Here's what they would do.
items.summary: The Post-Dispatch headline says Missouri voters will consider five statewide propositions and explains what they would do. The source is paywalled and only the headline was available, so the propositions themselves are not described here.

items.title: 2 Runners Qualified for the Olympic Trials at This Marathon. Then They Learned Their Times Won’t Count.
items.summary: Runner's World reports that two runners qualified for the Olympic Trials at the Baystate Marathon, then learned their times won't count. The race was unsanctioned, so these Trials hopefuls will likely have to try again.

items.title: Emma Grace Hurley’s Marathon Debut Was Years in the Making. Here’s How to Mimic Her Training When Going for 26.2.
items.summary: Runner's World says Emma Grace Hurley, the top American at Chicago, had a marathon debut that was years in the making. The piece argues her slower build shows how patience can lead to a faster marathon.

items.title: The Best Tune-Up Workouts to Help You Absolutely Crush This Year’s Turkey Trot
items.summary: Runner's World shares two coach approved tune up workouts meant to build 5K speed and sharpen your finishing kick before this year's Turkey Trot.
